semiconductor_relevance: High — Baikowski Japan provides high-purity oxide fine powders and specialized polishing slurries essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Baikowski Japan specializes in high-purity oxide fine powders and ultrafine particles such as alumina, spinel, and ceria. The company develops and supplies specialized polishing slurries tailored for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on minimizing surface roughness and achieving near-absolute flatness, which are critical for enhancing the performance and quality of semiconductor devices.
capabilities: Ultrafine alumina, spinel, and ceria particles
Specialized polishing slurries for semiconductor manufacturing
